sources.snippet: Krishi Sathi is an AI-powered platform designed to be every farmer's trusted companion, offering real-time, easy-to-understand insights and solutions for pest management, and crop yield prediction, currently for Onion and Grapes. sources.title: Krishi Saathi: a farmer-centric conversational assistant for scalable ...
sources.snippet: Krishi Saathi leverages RAG-QA framework to deliver personalized, localized, and multilingual agricultural advisories in realtime, overcoming limitations of existing agri-AI solutions with 95.93% accuracy on query intent recognition and 96.93% accuracy on parameter detection.

sources.snippet: Indian farmers often lack timely, accessible, and language-friendly agricultural advice, especially in rural areas with low literacy. To address this gap in accessibility, this paper presents a novel AI-powered agricultural chatbot, Krishi Sathi, designed to support Indian farmers by providing personalized, easy-to-understand answers to their queries through both text and speech.
